Miguel: I'll take 'alert throttling' (item 2). Target Wed 2024-06-12. Will update the ticket.
Samir: I can own 'redo Canary pipeline' but blocked by infra PR review (PR #4567). ETA Thu if review lands today.
Tess: I'm ok to own 'dashboard retention' but need acceptance from infra and data-team on retention window. @Samir any overlap?
Samir: Yes, Tess — pipeline will touch the same kinesis stream. Tagging @Carla for data-team signoff.
Carla: Acknowledge. I'll review today; can confirm by 5pm. Possible blocker: security needs to recheck env vars in the stream consumer.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled for canary tomorrow 09:30 UTC — will only proceed after code review and data signoff.
Asha: Ok — summary: Miguel(item2, Wed), Samir(item3, Thu if PR merged), Tess(item4, depends on data signoff), Carla(data signoff by 5pm). Action: Samir please link PR and toggle 'blocked' in the ticket if review is pending.
Samir: PR linked: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4567. Marked blocked until review done. @reviewers please take a look.
Miguel: noted. I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and due dates. If anything slips, call out asap in this thread. :thumbsup:
